title: Trial · limit popup
improvement: Explain the exhausted trial, automatic Pro date, price, and choice to wait.
note: Trial allowance policy comes from #15184; fresh paid usage comes from #15208.

title: Trial · in-chat notice
improvement: One neutral notice shows the start date and price; the draft stays editable.

title: Trial · exhausted allowance
improvement: One trial meter, the agreed renewal terms, and a clear option to start Pro now.

title: Trial · allowance remaining
improvement: One trial meter with its end date. The Pro card keeps the price and start date, and only suggests starting early once usage runs low.

title: Pro · daily limit
improvement: Show the actual next plan, benefits, price, and the option to wait.

title: Pro · in-chat notice
improvement: Replace the generic billing detour with a contextual Max offer.

title: Pro · both limits reached
improvement: The later weekly reset takes priority; both usage windows remain visible.

title: Pro · weekly limit
improvement: Correct the daily-limit wording and identify the weekly reset.

title: Max · daily limit
improvement: Put the next usable time first, with a restrained capacity contact.

title: Max · in-chat notice
improvement: A calm reset notice and direct contact replace the generic billing button.

title: Max · billing and capacity
improvement: Group plan, usage, and capacity help; keep payment details compact.

title: Team · weekly limit
improvement: Identify the plan and blocking week; offer the appropriate support action.

title: Team · billing and usage
improvement: Usage and organization billing become a coherent page with capacity help.

title: Enterprise · weekly limit
improvement: Clear weekly timing and a direct route to the account team.

title: Enterprise · billing and usage
improvement: Bring usage timing and account-team support together with organization billing.
note: Current production already uses organization-managed Enterprise billing. This comparison does not claim to introduce that fix.

title: Basic · legacy-plan notice
improvement: A contextual Pro action replaces a generic billing destination.

title: Basic · legacy-plan settings
improvement: Keep the existing entitlement visible alongside usage and upgrade options.

title: No active plan · plan selection
improvement: Explain product benefits, prices, and billing choices before choosing a plan.
note: Monthly example for a trial-ineligible account. Annual billing retains its derived savings label.

title: No active plan · settings
improvement: Show account context and the path back to a subscription.
note: Production currently covers billing with its plan paywall; the proposal makes these settings accessible.

title: Trial ended · recovery
improvement: Explain ended access and offer a fresh start in the conversation.
note: Before: existing billing trial status. Production has no dedicated in-chat equivalent.

title: Trial canceled · recovery
improvement: Respect the cancellation and offer a low-pressure way to return.
note: Before: existing billing trial status. The sample cancellation has already ended access.

title: Payment failure · recovery
improvement: State the amount owed and pay the open trial invoice on Stripe in one step, instead of a plan checkout that is refused while the invoice is open.
note: Before: existing payment-method management card; production has no equivalent recovery popup. After: the button opens the open trial invoice on Stripe’s hosted page.

title: Payment failure · settings
improvement: One message with the amount and one button that pays the open invoice. No refused Start Pro checkout and no duplicate payment cards.
note: Before: generic Pro billing; no dedicated payment-failure state. After: recovery only when billing confirms suspended access.

title: Usage unavailable · in-chat feedback
improvement: Explain the missing usage data and offer retry without displaying a false zero.
absence: Production has no dedicated in-chat usage-unavailable component.
absenceDetail: The existing usage-limit card renders nothing when its usage request is unsuccessful. The proposed notice adds an explicit retry state.

title: Usage unavailable · settings
improvement: One usage error with a retry in the Usage slot, while the plan card beside it stays as usual.

title: Connected provider · continuation
improvement: Keep a connected-provider continuation option next to the upgrade.
note: Before: provider continuation exists in the popup, but not in the in-chat limit card.

title: Start Pro · payment review
improvement: Review the trial ending early, exact charge, and next payment before paying.
absence: There is no early trial-to-Pro payment review in this production release.
absenceDetail: An active trial cannot use the existing tier-change operation. This proposed review depends on the new authenticated activation flow.
note: Sample billing quote. Actual charge, tax, period, and renewal terms come from Stripe. No invented card details.

title: Pro to Max · upgrade review
improvement: See the prorated charge, credit, tax, and renewal before upgrading to Max.
note: The quoted proration date is reused on confirmation. A failed preview offers retry and Keep Pro, never an unquoted UI charge.

title: Start Pro · payment processing
improvement: Wait for confirmed payment, entitlement, and usage reset before continuing.
absence: There is no early trial-to-Pro processing screen in this production release.
absenceDetail: The proposed flow stays pending until payment, entitlement, and usage reset are confirmed. It must not grant access from a redirect alone.

title: Pro activated · return to work
improvement: Confirm successful paid activation and fresh allowances before returning to work.
note: Before: ordinary paid composer. After: the actual activation-success dialog; no equivalent exists in production.

title: Pro activated · fresh allowance
improvement: Show fresh allowances after confirmed trial-to-paid activation.
note: Illustrative before usage is carried over. After zero usage depends on the reset receipt and successful data refresh.

title: Trial cancellation pending · billing
improvement: Keep remaining trial access and the parent’s explicit plan choices, without a duplicate automatic-start offer.
absence: No remaining-access cancellation state in this production snapshot.
absenceDetail: The new parent keeps trial access until its scheduled end. This capture shows the actual combined billing UI; no production equivalent is invented.

title: Trial cancellation pending · chat notice
improvement: Choose a plan explicitly after cancellation with Subscribe now, the label of the plan cards it opens; never promise that Pro will start automatically.
absence: No cancel-pending chat notice in this production snapshot.
absenceDetail: The new parent keeps trial access until its scheduled end. This notice links to plan selection rather than starting activation directly.

title: Payment failure · paywall
improvement: Past-due trials see the same message and pay button in the paywall instead of plan choices whose checkout is refused.
absence: No payment-failure paywall capture in this production snapshot.
absenceDetail: Production shows the plan choices from pair 18 here. While the trial invoice is open, their Start Pro checkout is refused, so this state pays that invoice instead.
